scope: User-requested exploratory snapshot of available audited bulk TRAINING answers only; no pilot pooling, no held-out fitting/evaluation, no final hypothesis tests or tuning.
regression: Same formula as final plan: success ~ (rating-1500)/500 + multi_move. Require at least 60 completed training rows, at least 15 successes and 15 failures, finite converged nonseparated fit. Ordinary 95% model-based intervals are provisional.
tree: Same depth-2 numeric CART and min_leaf=40 as final plan; same three predictors. Require at least 80 training rows and at least 15 successes and 15 failures. Descriptive training tree only; no held-out accuracy claim.
missing_model: Show an explicit unavailable-data panel; do not substitute the earlier pilot results.
final_plan: Unchanged; full N=1000 and fixed 800/200 split. I do not adapt sampling, predictors, prompts or hyperparameters from these interim results.
